rows: Tell me what I missed. Then give me a chance to show you I heard.
Brawling is a fair tool when it is used well. Would you show me how you use it?
A risk can teach me something. What would you like me to learn from yours?
Slow is a good pace for learning. Shall we go at that pace?
The people deserve a match worth their time. Would you help me give them that?
Short version: I would like a chance to prove I am ready.
I would like to be trusted to lead, and I know I still have to earn it.
Look at my stance. Does it look ready to you?
You say technique. What would you change in mine, if you could?
Strikes are part of learning the job. Tell me which ones you would start with.
A risk should be something we can talk about after. Would you like to talk about yours?
A stall is something I am trying to avoid. Would you show me what you would do instead?
The people want to see a contest. Would you let me give them one?
You call yourself among the best. What do you think I still need to learn?
You are proud of your {strength}. Would you show me what makes it work?
I have been trying to understand your {strength}, and I would like your help with it.
You kept calm. Good. Would you show me how you did it?
Fair. Thank you for saying that.
I could argue that. Would you like to test me on it instead?
One fall. Keep me down, and then tell me what I could do better.
On the mat I will ask you as I go. Tell me if I am wrong.
Grounded or standing, would you show me the next step?
Stay in front of me. I would like to learn from what you do.
Good answer. Thank you. Would you explain the reasoning?
You have not answered. I would really like your answer, if you have one.
Fair. I will try to remember that.
I accept that. Will you test me on it at the bell?
I will wrestle this match and I will listen to every correction you give me.
My approach is careful. I hope you will see me try my best on the night.
Whatever happens, I hope you will tell me what I learned.
It is not finished. I would like the chance to finish it well.
I have one more question for you, and I hope you will answer it when the bell rings.
